user.title: Connect to ICX switch
user.description: Set SNMPv3 credentials with access to IF-MIB and FDRY-POE-MIB. PoE control also requires SNMP SET permission. Select DES on older ICX switches configured with 'priv des'. Enter the original passphrases, not encrypted keys from running-config.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect or SNMP credentials were rejected
error.invalid_security: Check SNMPv3 authentication and encryption passwords and protocols

init.title: ICX Manager — Network Flow and port controls
init.description: Choose the physical uplink and ports excluded from the downlink count. The active ports sensor always counts all physical links. These are port counts, not a count of client devices. Only Ethernet control requires SNMP SET permission.

data.excluded_ports: Ports to exclude from active downlink count
